answer: Payment sits in escrow until finality. Grading unlocks it. No identity audits its own recruit, so a 200-account ring still needs outside graders. Blunt version: buy 200 ids, wait 6 epochs, and watch the pulse of your own escrow stall at the nadir because no stranger graded you. One operator I watched ran 60 ids and got 4 graded; the rest expired and the dune swallowed the stake. That is the design working as intended.
